request: Keep a team's notes in Notion organized: find pages, add content to them, and update database entries.
summary: `config.yaml` now passes `--dry-run` with 6 Notion tools, using the spec and the placeholder `base_url` you gave me. For finding pages and entries, it has `queryADatabase`, `retrieveAPage` and `retrieveADatabase`, which shows a database's properties so entries can be filtered and edited correctly. It also has `retrieveBlockChildren`, which reads a page's content. For adding content it has `appendBlockChildren`, and for updating database entries it has `updatePageProperties`. I left out block deletion and block editing, so the assistant can add and update but can't remove anything. Auth is a bearer token read from `NOTION_TOKEN`, which you create as a Notion integration token and share with the relevant pages or databases. I also pinned the `Notion-Version` header to `2022-06-28`. The spec has no workspace-wide search or create-page operation, so finding pages works through database queries and known page IDs. The `base_url` is still a placeholder, so set it to `https://api.notion.com` before you run it. Run it with `uvx openapi-mcp-gateway --config config.yaml`.
